annotations.title: Freelance (ZZP) hourly rate needed for a target net income

description: The hourly rate a freelancer (ZZP) in the Netherlands needs in 2026 to take home a target net amount a month, after holidays, sick days and hours that can't be invoiced, business costs, the entrepreneur deductions, income tax and the Zvw contribution.

business_costs.description: Yearly business costs excl. VAT, euros. Default 3000.

holiday_weeks.description: Weeks off a year, incl. public holidays. Default 6.

non_billable_percent.description: Share of working hours not invoiced (sales, admin), %. Default 20.

starter.description: Gets the starters deduction (one of the first five years). Default false.

target_net_monthly.description: Net income wanted a month, euros

name: freelance_hourly_rate
title: Freelance (ZZP) hourly rate needed for a target net income
